title: Vietnam’s VinSpace signs deal with Elon Musk’s SpaceX to launch its first satellites in 2027
description: The Vietnamese aerospace company VinSpace has signed a contract with SpaceX to launch its first satellites in 2027, marking a big step in Vietnam’s efforts to develop its space industry. The satellites will fly on a SpaceX Transporter rideshare mission, which carries multiple customers’ satellites on one rocket. VinSpace, part of the Vietnamese conglomerate Vingroup, will develop, manufacture and operate the satellites to test its technologies in orbit and support future commercial applications. Established in November 2025, VinSpace aims to become a full-service aerospace company. Its parent, Vingroup, is expanding into high-tech industries including electric vehicles, space, artificial intelligence and robotics.
